related_resources.reason: SWIR mapping estimates around 0.76 square km of rock gardens, below previous estimates; this is a model-dependent land-use measure, not a precontact population census.
Review of 1,434 dates emphasizes short-lived samples; proposed late eastern-Polynesian chronology is an evidence-driven model, not a log of named voyages.

Fifteen sequenced individuals dated 1670–1950 CE, simulations reject a severe 1600s bottleneck, admixture estimated c. 1250–1430; genetics does not specify the direction of an individual canoe voyage.

Drone photogrammetry authorized by Rapa Nui Comunidad Indígena Maʻu Henua identifies 30 distinct quarrying foci at Rano Raraku and tests decentralized production interpretations; the clustering does not date every carved figure.
